operatorProperties.code:
def process(water2012, water2013) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    def prep(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
        out = df.copy()
        # beach identifier
        beach_col = 'Beach Name' if 'Beach Name' in out.columns else None
        if beach_col is None:
            raise ValueError(f"Expected 'Beach Name' column; got {list(out.columns)}")

        # exceedance indicator: in these files it is 'Violation' with yes/no
        exc_col = 'Violation' if 'Violation' in out.columns else None
        if exc_col is None:
            raise ValueError(f"Expected 'Violation' column; got {list(out.columns)}")

        out = out[[beach_col, exc_col]].rename(columns={beach_col: 'beach', exc_col: 'violation'})
        s = out['violation']
        if pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(s):
            out['exceed'] = s.fillna(0).astype(float) != 0
        else:
            txt = s.astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
            out['exceed'] = txt.isin(['yes', 'y', 'true', 't', '1', 'exceed', 'exceeded'])
        return out[['beach', 'exceed']]

    d12 = prep(water2012)
    d13 = prep(water2013)

    rate12 = d12.groupby('beach').agg(samples12=('exceed', 'size'), exceed12=('exceed', 'sum')).reset_index()
    rate12['rate12'] = rate12['exceed12'] / rate12['samples12']

    rate13 = d13.groupby('beach').agg(samples13=('exceed', 'size'), exceed13=('exceed', 'sum')).reset_index()
    rate13['rate13'] = rate13['exceed13'] / rate13['samples13']

    merged = rate12.merge(rate13, on='beach', how='inner')  # excludes beaches with no 2012 samples
    count_higher = int((merged['rate13'] > merged['rate12']).sum())
    return pd.DataFrame([{'countHigher2013vs2012': count_higher}])

operators.customDisplayName: Compute per-beach bacterial exceedance rate for 2012 vs 2013 using columns 'Beach Name' as beach identifier and 'Violation' (yes/no) as exceedance indicator (map yes-like strings to exceed=True). Groupby beach to get samples and exceedances; compute rate = exceed/samples for each year. Inner-join beaches present in both years (excluding any with no 2012 samples). Count beaches where 2013 rate > 2012 rate; return single-row DataFrame with 'countHigher2013vs2012'.
